# Exception candidates for the owner — 50-line limit (generated by plan50.mjs; edit exception-candidates.head.md)

Owner decides each line; no job grants one and no job edits `development/scripts/size-exceptions.json`. Accepted
lines become `size-exceptions.json` entries (reason = the text here). Rejected lines go back to a Terra/hard job.
Executors add more during the run (`EXCEPTION-CANDIDATE` lines in their reports — components or hooks whose only
remaining over-50 part is one indivisible JSX tree or effect); the coordinator appends them here.

## Held — no split planned (<!-- COUNT --> items)
<!-- HELD -->

Reasons for the files held since the 100-line design:
- The 8 theme runtime scripts `content/themes/{static,__original-themes__/static}/{tovu-starter,tovu-theme}/scripts/{main,docs-toc}.js`:
  the same script duplicated per theme; a split must change every copy in lockstep and the originals' bytes.
- `recon-site.mjs` (`collectSignals`), `commerce/src/browser/checkout.ts`, `diagnostics/.../page-structure-script.ts`:
  functions serialized into a browser page (`fn.toString()` / `page.evaluate`), no outer scope allowed.
- `ui/src/react/components/Icon.tsx` `ICON_RENDERERS`: one flat artwork table, one entry per icon.
- `website/src/platform/db/sqlite/fresh-content-db.ts` `freshContentOperations`: one table keyed by migration id
  mirroring `CONTENT_MIGRATIONS`.

- `apps/admin/src/panels.tsx` (`PANELS` table vs split by sidebar group).
- `apps/website/src/features/identity/repo.ts` (ten sibling repo classes; split by table family planned).
- `apps/admin/src/lib/browser-stream.ts` (one closure state machine; split planned).
- `agent-daemon-scope.ts` `createSiteScope` (stays over until the move; ~30 tests read its statements by name).
